subject: Horizon pilot — adjusted success plan & scope add
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@horizonhealth.com>; Clinical Data Team <cli@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:12:00Z
Subject: Recap + proposed pilot next steps (Horizon Health)

Hi Alex / Clinical Data Team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to meet the Horizon team. Quick recap and a concrete proposal so we can lock the pilot scope and owners: 

1) Proposed pilot scope (4 weeks):
   - Intent extraction + entity tagging on clinical notes (primary)
   - Short-form answer generation for triage flows (secondary)

2) Draft success criteria (we'll finalize after data review):
   - Intent extraction: >= 92% precision on sampled ground-truth set
   - Answers: 85% helpfulness in a blind evaluation (Horizon raters)
   - Inference SLO: 95th pct token latency < 300ms under expected traffic

3) Evaluation plan / ownership:
   - Redwood: model serving, latency/throughput baseline, synthetic augmentation
   - Horizon: provide sample dataset, label subset for eval, and rater panel
   - Ben will lead the latency bench; Monica will coordinate onboarding & kickoff.

4) Next steps / asks from you by 11/05:
   - Confirm the dataset sample (CSV) we discussed
   - Any hard constraints we should encode (e.g., retention, PII handling)

Attaching a short pilot checklist template for ease of review. I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff once we have dataset confirmation.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: pilot-checklist-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Subject: Re: Recap + proposed pilot next steps (Horizon Health)

Laura — thanks for the clear recap. Quick notes from our side: 

- We like the proposed scope, but can you also include a small payments reconciliation use case? It touches the same ingestion pipeline and would be high-value if the model can reliably reconcile short receipts to charge IDs.
- Latency: we were hoping to see 95th pct token latency closer to 200–250ms if possible — low latency is important for triage flows.
- I'll attach the sample CSV we pulled (anonymized) and a short data-sharing checklist for compliance sign-off.

Assume we'll need 1–2 days internally to get the label subset approved. If adding the payments use case materially changes timeline, flag it.

—Alex

Subject: Re: Recap + proposed pilot next steps (Horizon Health) — feasibility notes

Alex / Laura,

I reviewed the sample CSV — good structure. A few feasibility notes and a proposed evaluation rubric that should keep the pilot scoped and measurable: 

Technical recommendations:
- Model profile: start with a 13B encoder-decoder variant quantized to int8 for cost/latency balance.
- Caching: enable prefix KV caching for repeated triage prompts (likely 20–30% token savings).
- Throughput target: assume batch size 8 for bulk labeling jobs, single-request streaming for UI paths.

Evaluation rubric (suggested):
- Intent extraction: precision >= 92% and recall >= 88% on labelled subset (Horizon labels)
- Entity extraction: F1 >= 0.90 for clinical identifiers in gold subset
- Payment reconciliation: correct-match rate >= 93% on sampled receipts
- Latency: 95th pct token latency < 250ms under expected quota (we can aim for 200ms but will confirm in bench)

I'll run a quick bench on our test infra and share numbers (attached CSV with initial latency points). If these thresholds look good, I'll produce a short quantization/config recipe we can run in Dedicated or Hosted.

Ben Carter
Infra Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: latency-benchmarks-rt1.csv (csv)

Subject: Pilot plan + owners (Horizon Health)

Hi all,

Following Ben's feasibility notes, I've sketched a 4-week pilot playbook and owners. High-level:

Week 0 (prep, data ingest) — Horizon: provide labelled subset + sign data sharing; Redwood: ingest + sanitize
Week 1 (model baseline) — Redwood: serve model, run latency bench; Horizon: smoke test UI integration
Week 2 (evaluation) — Horizon: blind ratings on answers; Redwood: entity/intent metrics + error analysis
Week 3 (wrap & handoff) — joint review, decide next steps (expand or iterate)

Ownership:
- Data approvals & labels: Alex (Horizon)
- Bench & model config: Ben (Redwood)
- Pilot coordination & kickoff: Monica (Redwood)

I've attached the playbook doc with more details (milestones, deliverables, acceptance checklist). Can you confirm by 11/10 so I can lock the kickoff?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Assuming the approval timeline, we should probably shift the kickoff by ~2 weeks; happy to proceed once legal has reviewed. HubSpot reference HS-23456.

—Alex

Subject: Horizon pilot — rebaseline & final next steps (scope v2)

Alex / Team,

Thanks for the signal and the compliance heads-up. After syncing with product and infra, we propose the following rebaseline so the pilot remains deliverable and measurable with the payments use case added: 

Updated pilot length: 6 weeks (to accommodate legal review + extra SME work)
Updated scope additions:
- Add payments reconciliation use case as a scoped mini-pipeline (match receipts -> charge IDs)
- Keep intent/entity work as primary success path

Updated success criteria (v2):
- Intent extraction: precision >= 92% on Horizon-labelled set
- Entity extraction: F1 >= 0.90 on clinical identifiers
- Payments reconciliation: correct-match rate >= 93% on a 500-sample test set
- Latency: 95th pct token latency < 250ms for UI paths; background batch jobs can run with relaxed SLO

Evaluation plan & ownership (final):
- Horizon: provide labelled subset, payment samples, and rater panel (Alex)
- Redwood infra: bench & config (Ben)
- Redwood CS: pilot coordination and weekly status (Monica)

Next steps (this week):
1) Horizon: confirm Data-Sharing-Checklist items and expected sign-off date
2) Redwood: prepare quantization recipe and sandbox endpoints for smoke test (Ben)
3) Schedule kickoff (post-legal approval) — proposing tentative window 2026-12-01 to 2026-12-07

I've attached the updated scope doc and a draft SOW-lite for review. If that looks good, I'll send a calendar invite for a 30-minute kickoff placeholder and a short DocuSign for the SOW-lite.

Thanks — looking forward to kicking this off.

Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
